research: https://studybreaks.com/tvfilm/channel-5-man-on-the-street — the trademark is an oversized beige suit, worn sweaty and uncomfortable; he says little and nods (posture: slumped, deadpan, mic offered out)

https://www.thestranger.com/slog/2021/07/26/59454269/all-gas-no-brakes-has-died-but-seattles-own-andrew-callaghan-has-been-resurrected — oversized tan suit carried from the old show into the new; oversized yet too-short trouser legs; corded mic held out to passers-by

https://dev.to/googleai/getting-the-most-out-of-nano-banana-2-502k — Google's own guide: scene and subject first, then style, light, constraints; state the aspect ratio in the prompt; say 'the attached image' when using a reference; grounding cannot search people
https://www.veed.io/learn/nano-banana-prompting-guide — the model responds to real photographic language: focal length, aperture, film stock
https://www.curify-ai.com/blog/10-prompting-tips-nano-banana — film stock and grain words pull it off the glossy stock look
https://fliki.ai/blog/nano-banana-2-prompting-guide — write a brief, not a keyword list
notes: The suit is well sourced (oversized beige/tan, trousers too short, corded mic offered out, deadpan nod). The HAT is NOT: no source I found names a trademark hat, so a battered tan felt fedora is my guess; swap it if Jack meant a different hat. The 'long-foam' mic is written as a corded mic with a fat foam head. Ref 2 (watermarked) is never attached; SU2-a describes the subway idea in words. Money appears in the supply beat (SU2-a fanned notes, SU2-b notes falling) seen edge-on/fluttering so no printing reads. Spread: bench portrait 50mm warm (RU2-a), dusk 200mm crowd (RU2-b), subway slow shutter (SU2-a), bridge street 28mm hard sun (SU2-b), night sodium 85mm close-up of empty gloved hands (FX2-a), dawn high angle tiny figure (FX2-b). The outfit phrase is shared on purpose across all six for character consistency; everything else differs. No real names in any prompt.

stills.prompt: Vertical 9:16 street portrait, setting and colour as the attached photo: bench, chain-link fence, payphone booths, warm late sun, faded 1980s film. Sitting centre, knees wide, a figure in a baggy beige thrift-shop suit, trousers too short, a battered tan fedora over a black balaclava, a foam-headed corded microphone on one knee. The balaclava has no eye, nose or mouth holes, so no skin shows anywhere; a large white ring is stitched round the whole face, and one small red triangle with rounded corners, pointing down, sits high inside the ring on the right-hand side of the picture. Gloves on both hands; no robot parts. Flanking him, an older woman in a tracksuit and a lanky teenager pose like a crew. 50mm, grain, no lettering. Thanks.
